app_tagline: Restore missing information in your Immich library
auth_intro: Sign in with your Immich account. You will see and change only your own library.
auth_help_steps: In Immich, open Account Settings → API Keys → New API Key.
auth_help_storage: The key is stored encrypted on the server of this app and is never sent back to the browser.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_core_unreachable: The app server does not respond.
error_server_not_configured: The app is not configured yet: set the Immich address and the secret key on the server.
error_immich_unreachable: The Immich server does not respond.
error_immich_missing_permissions: The API key lacks permissions: {permissions}. Edit the key in Immich and try again.
error_immich_permission_denied: Immich refused the request: the API key lacks a permission.
photo_video_note: Video: the preview frame is shown.
photo_coordinates_invalid: Could not read the coordinates. Examples: 42.4249, 18.7713 or 42°25'30"N 18°46'17"E
photo_keys_hint: Keys: 1–9 choose a suggestion, Enter save the location, ← → previous / next, S skip, N not applicable, U back to the to-do list, Z enlarge the photo, R recognize a part of the photo, [ ] rotate the photo, Esc gallery. Click the map to pick a point; a click near the dashed line between the neighbors lands on it.
error_immich_error: Immich returned an error. Please try again.
error_location_changed_in_immich: The location was changed in Immich after this app wrote it. Undo was cancelled so as not to overwrite it.
photo_save_note: The location is written to Immich a few seconds after saving; until then it can be cancelled.
photo_pending: The location of this photo will be saved in a few seconds.
error_location_null_island: Exactly 0, 0 cannot be saved: Immich treats it as "no location".
error_location_clear_failed: Immich did not remove the coordinates, so the saved point was kept.
photo_turned_note: Rotated here only, Immich is not changed. Modules started now get the photo rotated.
photo_rotation_saved: Rotation saved in Immich. The modules will look at the photo again.
photo_rotation_saved_later: Rotation saved in Immich; it is still making the new previews. The modules will look at the photo again after the next sync.
error_rotate_not_supported: Immich can rotate only photos, not videos.
auth_password_note: The password is checked by Immich and is not stored. On the first sign-in the app creates its own API key in your Immich account (named “immich-steward …”) and keeps it encrypted on its server.
auth_key_summary: Sign in with an API key instead
auth_key_intro: For example, if you sign in to Immich through OAuth and have no password.
auth_help_optional_edit: optional: saves a photo rotated in the app to Immich
auth_help_optional_download: optional: shows originals in full size
error_immich_invalid_credentials: Immich did not accept this email and password.
error_immich_password_login_failed: Immich refused password sign-in (it may be turned off on the server). Sign in with an API key instead.
module_note_no_neighbors: No photos with a location close in time.
module_note_scanner: Looks like a scan: its date is the scan date, so time neighbors are not suggested.
candidate_estimated: neighbor's location was set by hand
module_similar_none: No photos of the same place with a location in your library yet.
candidate_similar_details: Where the most similar photo of your library was taken. Similar photos of this place: {count}. Confidence is how often such a match turns out right within 1 km.
module_status_not_run: Not run on this photo yet.
module_no_candidates: No confident areas: the photo gives too little to go on.
module_no_worker: No worker running this module is connected now, so the run waits until one starts (see the Library page).
candidate_area: Area that looks like the photo
workers_intro: Workers run the heavy location modules (GeoCLIP, similar photos) on the server or on another computer.
workers_none: No worker has connected yet. See “GeoCLIP worker” in the installation guide.
workers_index: Search index of similar photos: {indexed} of {located} photos with a location.
workers_auto_off: Automatic runs are off; modules run only when started from a photo.
candidate_area_details: GeoCLIP compares the photo with 100 000 reference points around the world; {points} of the 200 most likely ones fall into this area. Confidence is their total probability.
suggestions_weak_more: {count} more weak suggestions (probably only the region is right)
filter_geoclip_confident_hint: Photos without a location that GeoCLIP marks as confident (75 % and above by default)
failure_image_unavailable: Immich could not give the photo (deleted, or Immich cannot make its preview)
failure_immich_auth: Immich refused the API key of the account
failure_image_invalid: The worker cannot read the photo
failure_module_error: The module failed on the photo
failure_worker_error: The worker could not report the result
failure_lease_expired_hint: Earlier versions of the app did not keep the real reason. Run it again to see it.
module_part_run: Recognize a part of the photo
module_part_hint: Select a part of the photo, e.g. a building behind people, and run the module on it only
region_title: Select a part of the photo
region_hint: Drag to draw a frame; drag its corners, sides or inside to adjust it. Wheel: zoom. Right or middle button, or Space + drag: move the photo. Esc: close.
region_too_small: Part: {w} × {h} px — very small, the module will hardly recognize anything in it.
device_same_only_hint: Count only photos of the same camera as this one; holds for the next photos too
